scope: 2025 completed, 2026 through verified Week 8; regular-season drafted player starts for original drafting manager only

definitions.draftValue: Points Above Round-and-Position Peers = recorded points scored while the drafted player was in the original manager's starting lineup minus the median of nonkeeper draft picks at the same position within approximately 2 rounds (expanding to 3, then 5, then full position when peer coverage is small). Excludes the target pick from its own baseline.
definitions.draftProduction: Starting-lineup points credited to the original drafting manager only. Bench scoring, other managers' post-trade starts and unplayed projections are excluded.
definitions.keeperObserved: For keeper selections, report kept round cost, credited starts, actual original-manager starter points, and comparison with the same-position starter median during those weeks.
definitions.keeperDecision: A grade for choosing this keeper over other realistically eligible alternatives is unavailable until the keeper-deadline roster, rules, candidate costs, and available alternatives are fully reconstructed.

limitations: Do not compare 2026 partial-season totals against 2025 full season as if equal exposure.
2026 draft engine contains Weeks 1–6; Week 7–8 starter points are appended only from original-team Sleeper weekly snapshots.
Original pick production after a trade does not count toward the original drafting manager; this is not a player total points ranking.
Keeper selections are excluded from draft pick efficiency rankings, while keeper draft cost is preserved in a separate category.
Peer medians are descriptive estimates of observed selections, not draft-day projections, replacement-level alternatives, or causal draft decision effects.
Keeper opportunity cost / decision grades are withheld until verified keeper-deadline alternatives exist.
